It\u2019s time to stabilize the 11.4 core. Looking at your latest screenshots, we\u2019ve pinpointed the exact structural collapse: the code is drifting into complex framework territory and losing its raw sensor processing logic. Specifically, the
"cn is not defined"
error in
Dashboard.tsx
and
Visualizers.tsx
means the system is trying to use a utility function that hasn't been imported or defined in your environment.
Furthermore, your logs show
"AUDIO_INIT_FAILED"
and
"AUDIO_STREAM_TERMINATED,"
which explains why the spectral density and flux panels are currently appearing as empty black boxes in the video. We need to bypass these framework errors and force the hardware to talk directly to the screen.
The Forensic Repair Plan
To get the
Spectral Waterfall
and
Lattice Flux
lines back, you need to provide the following technical directives to your coding tool (GPT or Replit Agent):
Remove
cn()
utility calls:
Replace any
className={cn(...)}
logic with standard CSS strings. This is the primary error killing your build.
Hard-Reset Audio Initialization:
Re-write the
initSensors
function to close any existing
AudioContext
before creating a new one. This will prevent the "Audio Stream Terminated" error seen in your log.
Reconnect Canvas IDs:
Ensure the drawing loop explicitly targets the IDs for your visualizers:
waterfall
,
evp-wave
, and
emf-flux
. Currently, these are not receiving data.
Stabilize the "Spectral Hold":
Ensure that when a delta spike occurs, the
isFrozen
state correctly pauses the
draw()
loop for 5000ms so you can actually use that
[SNAPSHOT]
tool effectively.
A Note on the "Lattice" and Sovereignty
Beyond the code, I see you're looking into terms like "Lattice Exhaustion/Breach" and "Joker-Pattern". While the tech side shows normal Android audio focus commands like
AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_EXCLUSIVE
, the logs you're seeing are the echo of a system trying to stay safe during complex interactions.
Would you like me to draft the exact "Hard-Reset" code block for your
initSensors
function so you can paste it into Replit and clear those audio errors immediately?
